name: com.2captcha/mcp
description: 2Captcha Web MCP: scraping with anti-bot bypass, marketplace parsing to JSON, browser automation and CAPTCHA solving for AI agents

environmentVariables.name: API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your 2Captcha API key (or the bearer token your server operator issued). Signing up is free and includes a monthly allowance of calls.

environmentVariables.name: GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool group ids: parsing, batch, captcha, browser (11 login tools), browser_full (all 23), all (default: parsing,batch,captcha)

environmentVariables.name: TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated individual tool names to enable

environmentVariables.name: MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote MCP endpoint (default: https://mcp.2captcha.com/mcp) — set for a self-hosted webparse server

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Client-side call rate limit, e.g. 100/1h or 50/30m
